core_big_goal: Under the current Fabric governance contract, with HG-KSEOS as the only control plane and the canonical Hermes bound as its governed Runtime/Orchestration plane: use FAR over every residual, gap, owner-decision item, session closure and repository publication; rule the best low-friction, high-necessity, non-over-engineered engineering option; EXECUTE that ruling; then close, hand over and publish the implementation and evidence to github.com/shw097-team/Fabric.

PLAN_in_hermes.how_proven: Two surfaces re-derived this round: (a) the governed profile's own state.db carries serving rows for openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol on the official Codex base_url (mode=subscription_included); (b) the formal HERMES_HOME resolution probe exits 0 and resolves to profiles/hgk-governed. No NEW one-shot reply/tool probe was dispatched this round, and the round says so rather than implying one.

corrections.what: the gate's own self-acceptance check (G4) COULD NOT FAIL for the reason it was written for. Its pattern was r'canonical_acceptance["\\s:]+(?!NOT_PERFORMED)' -- and a greedy character class followed by a negative lookahead simply BACKTRACKS to a shorter match, so the lookahead around NOT_PERFORMED was always satisfiable. It therefore flagged every document that mentioned the key, including the ones that say NOT_PERFORMED, and would also have missed a genuine positive written without the key word. Replaced with a direct document-level assertion (a file that mentions canonical_acceptance must also contain NOT_PERFORMED).
